metadata.name: NMDANeuron
metadata.author: Wang, X.-J.
metadata.description: Pyramidal LIF neuron with a two-stage saturating NMDA autapse

dynamics.v: Wang pyramidal LIF balance with NMDA autapse and optional calcium AHP

threshold.detection: sampled-grid upward event; reset and absolute refractory hold

extensions.source_equations: Wang 1999 equations 1, 2, 4, and 5; Jahr-Stevens magnesium block
extensions.input_contract: current is the applied current I_app in nA; emitted events drive the scalar autapse
extensions.identity_note: Former project composite retained separately as SCWBNMDAMagnesiumBlockNeuron
extensions.hardware_note: No RTL, synthesis, formal-equivalence, timing, PPA, device, or silicon claim
